description: The plot, titled "BBQ," illustrates the relationship between the number of demonstrations and accuracy for four different configurations. The x-axis is labeled "#Demonstrations" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1500, with tick marks at regular intervals of 250. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy" and uses a linear scale with visible tick marks at 45, 50, and 55. The "Squared-Exponential" configuration is represented by a dark blue solid line with circular markers; it begins at an accuracy of approximately 53 near 0 demonstrations, rises steeply to about 57 at 250 demonstrations, and continues to increase steadily, reaching approximately 63 near 1400 demonstrations. The "Tanh" configuration is shown as a medium blue solid line with circular markers, starting at an accuracy of roughly 49 near 0 demonstrations and exhibiting a steady upward trend to end at approximately 56 near 1400 demonstrations. The "ELU" configuration is depicted by a light purple solid line with circular markers, beginning at an accuracy of about 47 near 0 demonstrations and increasing steadily to conclude at approximately 54 near 1400 demonstrations. Finally, the "LLaMA-2-chat-7B" configuration is represented by a pink dash-dot line without markers, which maintains a constant accuracy of approximately 48.5 across the entire x-axis range.
